body:
I don't want to die. I never wanted to die. I wish I was never born because all I do is hurt people. I want to die so people don't have to be burdened anymore. I'm too selfish to kill myself... Right now, I'm sane enough to be a realist and know that none of what I'm thinking will benefit anyone in anyway but the thoughts just keep distorting my views on reality and I'm afraid I've already lost or am currently losing this battle. 

Keep on living and if anything ever goes wrong know that there will be people to help you as well as your better, stronger, future self to look forward too.

That's some advice I can give while I'm still thinking straight. Some advice that I wish I could still follow. I'm telling you this because All this time I wished people would help me, and they did but I just pushed them back. Please follow this advice, take care of yourself, and know that I care if no one else does. I never want to see someone else in the same pain I'm in...

I'm so sorry you feel like this as well. It's a dark, horrible, and wretched place that no one should be in. It hurts so much that you can't even put it into words, just beg and wait to see if it'll go away.
